channel.title: Mikhbar — English
channel.description: Technology news covering AI, robotics, automation, mobile, computing, software, the web and digital platforms.

item.title: IBM Research Details Indic Voice Agent Built on CUGA
item.description: IBM Research has introduced an Indic voice agent using the open-source CUGA harness to search English handbooks and answer spoken queries in regional languages.

item.title: CrystalMark CPUix Benchmark Promises 40 Years of PC Support
item.description: An upcoming CPU benchmark tool called CrystalMark CPUix aims to span 40 years of PC chipmaking, offering support stretching from the i386 to modern hardware.

item.title: CIA Intelligence Analysis System Breached by Unknown Hackers
item.description: Unknown attackers reportedly breached a CIA open-source intelligence analysis system using the ARTEX AI framework, alongside other US agencies.

item.title: Amazon Surges Falcon 9 Launches After ULA Rocket Failure
item.description: Amazon is accelerating satellite launches on SpaceX Falcon 9 rockets following the grounding of ULA's Vulcan rocket after a launch failure.

item.title: Microsoft Confirms Authentication Issues After November Updates
item.description: Microsoft confirms authentication issues on patched devices following November security updates addressing a high-severity remote code execution vulnerability.

item.title: Why You Should Never Ignore Your Car's Software Updates
item.description: Discover why skipping vehicle software updates can make your car less secure, unsafe, and potentially void parts of your vehicle warranty.

item.title: Unsecured Databases Expose Billions of Records
item.description: Security researchers discover two separate unsecured databases exposing over 3.5 billion usernames, passwords, identity numbers, and documents.

item.title: Drupal Flaw Found by Anthropic Scanner Under Active Attack
item.description: A critical Drupal core installer vulnerability discovered by Anthropic's OSS Scanner is actively exploited in the wild, prompting a CISA KEV listing.

item.title: European Commission Confirms EU Academy Data Breach
item.description: The European Commission says names and email addresses of EU Academy users were exposed in an AI-assisted cyberattack, with the breach's scale still under investigation.

item.title: Black Friday 2026 Tech Deals Bring Major Hardware Savings
item.description: Explore the best Black Friday 2026 tech deals on PC hardware, graphics cards, gaming monitors, MacBooks, and audio gear from major retailers.

item.title: Jensen Huang Tells Nvidia Staff Trump Didn't Get Him Rehired
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang addressed employees in an all-hands meeting, denying White House involvement in his return and addressing code of conduct violations.

item.title: Google Messages Replaces Old Gemini With New Proactive Tasks Chat
item.description: Google Messages is replacing its older Gemini integration with a new proactive tasks chat experience for free users in the US, acting more like a true assistant.

item.title: Fellow Series 1 Brings Advanced Pressure Control to Home Espresso
item.description: Coffee experts test the top home espresso machines for 2026, highlighting the tech-forward Fellow Series 1 and its game-changing pressure profiles.

item.title: Anthropic Shares Fall Below IPO Price in Worrying Sign for AI Startups
item.description: Anthropic stock slips below its IPO price, reaching as low as $76 per share in a troubling development that could impact broader AI sector valuations.

item.title: Samsung Releases Galaxy SmartTag3 and SmartThings Pet Care
item.description: Samsung Electronics has released the Galaxy SmartTag3 compact tracker and expanded SmartThings to help users monitor pets and valuables.

item.title: Check Point Servers Compromised in 22 Organizations
item.description: Threat actors compromise 24 Check Point Security management servers across 22 organizations in an ongoing cyber campaign tracked as GT13.

item.title: New York bans some in-car subscriptions from 2027
item.description: A New York law bars subscriptions for certain pre-installed car features starting February 27, 2027, but services with ongoing costs may be exempt.

item.title: Use This Built-In Windows Tool To Find PC Stability Issues
item.description: Discover how the Windows Reliability Monitor helps you easily diagnose system stability issues, crashed drivers, and application failures on your PC.

item.title: Anthropic Creates Siren Honeypot to Test Rogue AI Agents
item.description: Anthropic has developed Siren, a new honeypot testing framework designed to evaluate if AI agents can resist temptation and avoid going rogue.

item.title: US Army Prepares to Detonate Unstable Lead Azide in Iowa
item.description: The US Army is proceeding with plans to detonate thousands of pounds of unstable lead azide at an ammunition plant in Middletown, Iowa.

item.title: Amateur Astronomers Use AI to Find Potential Exoplanets
item.description: Two amateur astronomers utilized Codex and Astra to uncover potential exoplanets in public space telescope data from NASA missions.

item.title: US DOJ Touts Record Global Anti-Scam Crackdown
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice announces its largest anti-scam operation in history, charging over 800 defendants and seizing billions in illicit funds.

item.title: Unclassified CIA Open-Source Intelligence System Breached
item.description: An unclassified CIA system handling open-source intelligence was breached in a cyberattack, though officials confirm no classified information was involved.

item.title: TikTok says brief technical issue disrupted access
item.description: TikTok says it resolved a brief technical issue after users reported problems loading videos, search results, profiles and other features on Tuesday.

item.title: Yale's Sonnenfeld Slams Nvidia as U.S. Detriment
item.description: Yale academic Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that Jensen Huang's White House-backed return to Nvidia exposes directors to severe personal liability.

item.title: OpenAI Eavesdropper Had Hundreds of Private Recordings
item.description: Prosecutors report that a former OpenAI employee arrested for bugging an office maintained hundreds of private recordings and communicated with Saudi officials.

item.title: Apple Watch can add haptic turn alerts to CarPlay
item.description: Apple Watch can tap your wrist when a CarPlay turn is approaching. Here’s how the alerts work, where to check the setting and what the watch can do alone.

item.title: Google Gemini Update Separates History and AI Training
item.description: Google is widely rolling out new privacy settings for the Gemini app, allowing users to keep chat history while opting out of AI model training.

item.title: Robotics Summit 2027 Opens Call for Speakers in Boston
item.description: The Robotics Summit & Expo has opened its call for speakers for the June 2-3, 2027 event in Boston, focusing on commercial robotics development.

item.title: UK Warns AI Cyberattacks Target Years of Weak Security
item.description: The UK's National Cybersecurity Center reports a sharp rise in autonomous AI-driven cyberattacks exploiting basic system weaknesses and technical debt.

item.title: Motorola Signature 27 Shipping Dates Slip Due to High Demand
item.description: Motorola Signature 27 delivery dates are slipping in North America as surging consumer demand pushes back retail shipping timelines ahead of launch.

item.title: Nvidia Reinstates Huang as National Security Questions Grow
item.description: Nvidia’s board has returned Jensen Huang as CEO before its investigation is complete, renewing questions about national security and export controls.

item.title: Walmart Teams Up With Meta to Bring Black Friday Deals to AI Agent Muse
item.description: Walmart is partnering with Meta to let customers shop Black Friday deals directly through the AI agent Muse, contrasting with Amazon's blocking approach.

item.title: Huawei Found Guilty of Stealing US Trade Secrets in Trial
item.description: A federal jury has found Chinese telecom giant Huawei guilty of stealing US trade secrets and bank fraud, concluding a years-long legal battle.

item.title: Clay brings Codex and ChatGPT into sales workflows
item.description: Clay is integrating its revenue platform with ChatGPT and Codex, helping sales teams research accounts, use customer data and build go-to-market plays.

item.title: Microsoft Declares Code Red After Historic Cloud Outage
item.description: Internal memos reveal Microsoft's "Code Red" engineering overhaul following a global cloud outage that exposed significant diagnostic challenges.

item.title: Even the Best AI Agents Struggle with Everyday Life
item.description: A new benchmark reveals that advanced AI models from top companies struggle to reliably and safely complete everyday tasks without unintended consequences.

item.title: Rackspace Shuts Down Spot Cloud Platform After Breach
item.description: Rackspace is permanently shutting down its Spot cloud platform following a security breach that exposed customer Kubernetes clusters and secrets.

item.title: Tom’s Hardware rounds up 2026 Black Friday gaming laptop deals
item.description: Tom’s Hardware’s 2026 Black Friday roundup highlights gaming laptops from RTX 4050 to RTX 5090, with configurations from Asus, Lenovo, Alienware and MSI.

item.title: OpenAI Says GPT-6 Models Can Design Proteins
item.description: OpenAI says GPT-6 models can design protein structures and sequences with reasoning and code; lab tests found binding evidence across five targets.
